title: Metro Tulsa Foot & Ankle Specialists says a cyber incident copied data; SoulGroup also lists it as a claim
date_note: Date of the practice's own notice; the notice says unusual activity was noticed on or about July 29, 2026.
geo_basis: practice's name and Oklahoma location per Becker's Spine Review
summary: Metro Tulsa Foot & Ankle Specialists says in a notice dated October 28 that it experienced a cyber incident. It says it became aware of unusual activity in its network on or about July 29, 2026, and that information may have been copied without authorization on July 30. The SoulGroup ransomware group listed the practice on its leak site on November 19; the practice has not commented on that listing.
plain: A foot and ankle practice in Oklahoma says a cyber incident may have let information be copied without authorization. It says it is notifying people by mail and offering credit monitoring.
exec: A medical practice has told patients that data may have been copied in a cyber incident; a ransomware group has also listed it.
action: Metro Tulsa says it is notifying affected people by mail and offering credit monitoring; use the practice's dedicated line in its notice with questions.
impact: Information may have been copied without authorization, per the practice's notice.

sources.name: Metro Tulsa Foot & Ankle Specialists, notice of data privacy event

validation.note: The practice's own notice, read, states the incident; Becker's Spine Review relays it. The SoulGroup listing (19 Nov) is the group's claim only.
